**Guardian Keeper's answer, from my knowledge source only**

**(1) Breaches or failures on dag 10 and dag 22**

- **Dag 10:** GUA-019 records poort's benedenstad shield at 04:47 as "van binnenuit geopend, 2 minuten", with "zegels intact, geen breuk, oorzaak niet vastgesteld". GUA-111 gives the same 04:47 time.
- **Dag 22:** GUA-043 records poort oost at 04:15 as "van binnenuit geopend, 3 minuten", with "geen sporen van inbraak van buitenaf". GUA-044 at 04:30 records the outside seals as intact and no one seen outside the wall. GUA-115 gives the same 04:15 time.
- GUA-115 also says the archive entered the wachters' melding at 01:50, before the opening. My source does not say what that melding concerned. I earlier called this clerical error in GUA-115, but that was my judgment. I cannot explain it from my source, and it is consistent with the Historian's HIS-103 concern.
- GUA-116 (dag 23) describes two more inside-openings, but no CSV row records them. My claim of an infiltrant there is my belief, not a recorded finding. GUA-120 says that investigation is still open.
- No other breach or failure appears. GUA-120 finds no defect in the shields.

**(2) Governing articles**

My source has no article on shutdown or reconnection. The relevant articles are:
- Art. 1, GUA-102 (shields)
- Art. 2, GUA-103 (maat: the shield follows the Kroonklok pulse, and a wachter does nothing to it)
- Art. 3, GUA-104 (binnenverkeer: traffic judged to come from inside is let through without a check)
- Art. 4, GUA-105 (zegels)
- Art. 5, GUA-106 (rondes; poortposten unmanned by ronde from 03:00 to 06:00)
- Art. 6, GUA-107 (onderhoud: stones reloaded one shield at a time, daytime only)
- Art. 7, GUA-108 (meldplicht)

None of these forbids or constrains a full shutdown during the hulpslag activation at dag 10 02:40. My source does not mention the hulpslag, so I cannot link any article to ENG-011.

**(3) Dag 9 approval (ENG-105)**

I have no record of ENG-105, of "hogerhand", or of "ruchtbaar". No shield or gate record shows a sign-off, and no signer is named. My dag 9 entries (GUA-017, GUA-018) are routine.
